visual.description: Full-viewport video/image background with centered text overlay ('THE ART OF LEATHER GOODS') and a single underlined CTA link positioned center-bottom of the frame.
Two-row navigation: top row is a dark green bar with icon (location pin) left, logo center, icon (account) right; second row is a lighter green bar with 4 equally-spaced uppercase nav items centered.
Three equal-width product cards on a warm off-white background, each with a centered product image above two lines of small-caps text (product name + 'See all the colors').

Section titled 'EXPLORE THE WORLD OF GOYARD' with two unequal-width image columns below: left column is narrower with a square editorial image and an Instagram handle beneath, right column is wider with a taller editorial image.
Left ~35% carries large serif display text ('THE ART OF MARQUAGE'), a subtitle, and an underlined CTA; right ~65% is a full-bleed product photograph with no text.
Full-width image section with 'DUAL NATURE' text overlaid in large white uppercase at the bottom-left of the frame, text partially cropped by the viewport.
Section titled 'THE SEASONS OF GOYARD' with three equal-width product cards on an off-white background, each showing a centered product image above a single small-caps product name.
Dark section with left ~55% containing heading, body text, email input, and submit button; right ~45% contains an illustrated editorial image (cartoon character reading a book).

Dark green section with a 3-up carousel: center card is full-size and foregrounded, left and right cards are partially cropped at the edges; chevron navigation arrows flank the center card; boutique name and address are centered below.

Dark green footer with four equal-width columns of links under uppercase category headings (Customer Service, Maison Goyard, Legal Information, Accessibility), followed by centered logo, wordmark, and a row of 7 circular social media icons.
